why.basis: Live barish, mati laga pani, pahar laga dhal, pathor laga kisim aru bhumikampa laga data pora niyom hisab te kora score ase. Etu khali ishara ase, guarantee nohoi — hodai sarkar laga kotha manibi.

preview.note: Etu jaga laga pahar, rasta, noi, gas aru agote hoi juwa landslide laga data public jaga pora (SRTM, OpenStreetMap, MODIS, NASA) loi kene rakhise. Pathor laga kisim, fault laga duur aru khotra te thaka manu aru jaga etiya bhi check kora nai — khotra level to andaj hisab te sabi. Mausam, bhumikampa aru AI model Sikkim nisina cholai ase.
